description: Pinched middle — used for wasp waists, hourglass shapes, and narrowed transitions between body segments.

foldRecipe.description: Valley-fold both sides inward at the midpoint to create the pinch
Mountain-fold the pinched section to lock the narrowed waist
Reverse-fold above and below the pinch to flare back out to full width
foldRecipe.landmark: Upper and lower boundaries of the pinch

foldRecipe.description: Valley-fold the top and bottom edges for clean termination
